Mae Fah Luang University
Admission Guide 2026
• Applicants must hold a non-Thai nationality and possess a foreign passport or
have a certificate of personal status issued by an authorised organisation.
• Applicants must demonstrate a genuine interest in studying at
Mae Fah Luang University.
• Applicants must not have any conditions that could affect their studies.
• Applicants must be currently enrolled in Grade 12 or Year 13, or have graduated
from Grade 12 or Year 13 from an international school in Thailand certificated by
the Office of the Private Education Commission (OPEC), or 2.5 Applicants must
have graduated from the upper secondary education level or equivalent
according to one of the following systems:
Applicants must have results from at least 3 subjects in one
of the following:
• GCE ‘A’ Level with grades A*-E.
• LRN International A Levels with grades A*-E.
• Cambridge Pre-U with grades M1 or D1-D3
• GED taken prior to May 2017: A total score of not less than 2,250 across 5
subjects, with a minimum of 410 in each subject.
• GED taken from May 2017 onwards: A score of at least 145 points in each
of the 4 subjects.
(1) Applicable for graduates from the Academic Year 2024 onwards:
National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) under
New Zealand Qualifications Authority (NZQA) at least 80 credits
achieved with:

- NCEA Level 2 or above 60 credits and

- Not less than 20 credits from the Literacy and Numeracy co-requisite
subjects.

(2) Applicable for graduates from the Academic Year 2010 - 2023: Applicants
must pass the New Zealand National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA)
subjects, under New Zealand Qualifications Authority (NZQA), at least 80 credits,
consisting of:
- Subjects at Level 2 or higher, totaling not less than 60 credits, and
- Subjects at Level 1 or higher, totaling not less than 20 credits.
English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) is counted as 1 subject.
The graduate must receive an NCEA Level 2 certificate, Record of Achievement,
and a certificate verifying the level, number of subjects, and credits of each subject
from the New Zealand Qualifications Authority (NZQA).
(3) Applicable for graduates from the Academic 2009: Applicants must pass the
New Zealand National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) subjects,
under New Zealand Qualifications Authority (NZQA), at Level 2 or higher, in at least 5
different subjects, at least 60 credits, consisting of 2 compulsory subjects:
- English (literacy) at Level 2 or higher, at least 4 credits.
- Mathematics (numeracy) at Level 2 or higher, at least 4 credits.
- English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) is not counted.
The graduate must receive a Record of Achievement and a certificate verifying the
level, number of subjects, and credits of each subject from the New Zealand
Qualifications Authority (NZQA).
• INTERNATIONAL BACCALAUREATE (IB)
(1) International Baccalaureate Diploma, that a total score of 5 subjects and
1 elective course with a minimum score of 24 and pass the Extended Essay (EE),
Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and Creativity, Action & Service (CAS) criteria according
to International criteria. Baccalaureate Organization (IBO) or
(2) IB Diploma Course Results ( IBCR) with not less than grade 3 on

at least 5 different subjects.
(3) IBCP Certificate: Not less than grade 3 in at least 2 IB Diploma Programme
courses , passing the Career-related Study Track subjects, and passing the Reflective
Project with a grade of D or higher.
• BUSINESS & TECHNOLOGY EDUCATION COUNCIL (BTEC)
• Other systems equivalent to the upper secondary education
level or the highest basic education curriculum of each country
(Secondary School) or from an institution certified by the relevant
government or international organisations
• Specific requirements of Programmes are provided on page 8 -12

English Language Requirements
Thai Language Requirements
• Applicants must have the qualification in accordance with
the requirements in either 1. or 2., details as follows:
1. Applicants must have the English proficiency test result not less than
the following requirements:
The test result should not exceed two years since the examination date.
2. Applicants must have graduated from high schools where English is
the primary medium of instruction. Applicants must also submit a Certificate
of English as Medium of Instruction issued by the school to the university.

• In the case that applicants do not have the English proficiency test result
as stated in 1. and do not graduate from high schools as stated in 2. but
have other academic qualifications that meet requirements of the
programme, the School shall accept applicants with conditions as follows:

- Applicants are required to take the Placement Test prepared
by the School of Liberal Arts. The Placement Test fee is 500 Baht per test. If
the applicants have a passing score of 60%, they shall be accepted
to study by the School.
- If applicants do not achieve a passing score of 60% on the Placement
Test, they are required to enroll in the Intensive English Courses for one
semester during their first semester of study until they achieve a passing grade.
Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in Thai listening,speaking, reading and
writing.; • Laws | • Public Health | • Traditional Chinese Medicine

Mae Fah Luang University
Admission Guide 2026
: Choose Your Programme
• Choose one programme that you wish to apply for from the list of programmes offered for
international students. If any further information is required, please visit
https://en.mfu.ac.th/admission/admission-guide.html or email: interadmission@mfu.ac.th
: Submit Application Form
• Applying online at https://en.mfu.ac.th/admission/admission-guide.html
System Instruction: https://shorturl.asia/uyjAk
: Receive Information
• An interview can be held by telephone or Skype video call. Other documents may be required;
in this case, further notification will be sent.
• A list of successful applicants will be announced on the online application system.
: Complete new student information
• Complete all personal information and upload all necessary documents to the new student
registration system
• Pay tuition fees and all expenses in Thai Baht (THB) currency
• Applicants will receive an official acceptance letter with the necessary visa request documents
and acceptance package via email/post.
: Arrive at the MFU Campus
• Inform the Global Relations Division of your arrival details for pickup services
from the Mae Fah Luang - Chiang Rai International Airport or Chiang Rai Bus Station
(1 week in advance).
• Undergraduate international students are guaranteed dormitory rooms on campus
for their first year of study at MFU.
